# Ugandhar Vaddi

> Personal portfolio, system architectures, enterprise data science, and applied machine learning of Ugandhar Vaddi.

Ugandhar Vaddi is an Associate Data Scientist at Tredence Analytics Solutions, building at the intersection of silicon, software, enterprise data pipelines, and applied machine learning models.

## Core Navigation & Links
- [Portfolio Homepage](https://ugandhar.in): Central engineering hub, bio, and direct contact.
- [Technical Blog & Journal](https://www.ugandhar.in/blog): In-depth engineering essays, reflections, and technical notes.
- [GitHub Profile](https://github.com/uga961): Open-source repositories, VLSI memory models, and native utilities.
- [LinkedIn Profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vaddi-ugandhar-b37877266/): Industry background, roles at Tredence, McKinsey & Company, and Cognizant.
- [YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@uga961): Multi-day Python classes, pandas data workshops, and technical tutorials.

## Featured Technical Articles by Ugandhar Vaddi
- [How I Debloated My Android TV: A Step-by-Step Guide Using ADB](https://www.ugandhar.in/blog/posts/debloat-android-tv-adb-guide): Practical step-by-step engineering guide on cleaning up slow Android TVs, configuring ADB over Wi-Fi, stripping pre-installed bloatware safely, and setting up minimal launchers by Ugandhar Vaddi.
- [Four Interviews, One Long Day, and a Chapter I'll Always Remember](https://www.ugandhar.in/blog/posts/mckinsey-interview-day-and-results): Detailed McKinsey & Company interview experience in Chennai, case studies, and career reflection by Ugandhar Vaddi.
- [Transforming Fedora into a Unified, macOS-Grade Desktop](https://www.ugandhar.in/blog/posts/transforming-fedora-into-unified-macos-grade-desktop): Deep-dive into styling GNOME Shell 50 on Fedora, reverse engineering Electron app controls, and compositor-level UI consistency by Ugandhar Vaddi.
- [Why I Built StayActive](https://www.ugandhar.in/blog/posts/why-i-built-stayactive): Architecture, background, and motivation behind building the StayActive native desktop wellness utility.
- [Python Data Visualization Guide](https://www.ugandhar.in/blog/posts/python-data-visualization-matplotlib-seaborn-guide): Hands-on masterclass on Matplotlib, Seaborn, heatmaps, and EDA workflows by Ugandhar Vaddi.

## Featured Engineering Projects
- [StayActive](https://github.com/uga961/StayActive): Native desktop wellness & ergonomics utility with intelligent meeting detection.
- [Cadence Virtuoso SRAM](https://github.com/uga961): Low-power 6T and 7T CMOS SRAM cell implementations.
- [Sexual Harassment NLP Classification](https://github.com/uga961/Sexual-Harrasment-Classification): Machine learning text classification pipeline for incident detection.
- [Draw2Spec](https://ugandhar.in/#projects): Proprietary enterprise AI-assisted engineering schematic digitizer built at McKinsey DtV Lab.
